body:
## Goal

Add a pattern folder entity inside a setup for linear and grid patterns, with undoable commands, MCP tools, project persistence, and expanded-move G-code posting. This is the smallest end-to-end slice of `#2938` (depends on the CL toolpath transforms sub-issue of `#2938`).

## Scope

- **Schema (`crates/app/src/schema.rs`):** Add a `PatternDef` component with `setup: Option<String>`, `suppressed: bool`, `order_mode` (`ByTool` default, `ByPart`), `kind` (`Linear { dir, count, spacing }`, `Grid { dir1, count1, spacing1, dir2, count2, spacing2 }`), `members: Vec<String>`, and `disabled_instances: Vec<u32>`. Use `OperationMeta::order` to position the folder in the setup list (same pattern as `ProgramEntry` in `crates/app/src/program_entry.rs`).
- **Rules:** All copies use the WCS of the parent setup (`crates/app/src/setup.rs`). An operation belongs to at most one folder in the same setup. Refuse nested folders. Validate finite positive counts and spacing at command creation.
- **Commands (`crates/app/src/commands/`):** Add undoable `CreatePatternFolder`, `EditPatternFolder`, `SetPatternMembers`, `SetPatternInstanceEnabled`, and `DeletePatternFolder` (ungroups member operations by default). Extend `ReorderOperation` and `RenameOperation` to support pattern folders.
- **MCP (`crates/app/src/mcp/`):** Add `create_pattern_folder`, `edit_pattern_folder`, `set_pattern_members`, `set_pattern_instance_enabled`, and `delete_pattern_folder`, and report pattern folders in `get_job`.
- **Project file (`crates/app/src/project/`):** Persist pattern folders as a new entity kind so older builds refuse the file cleanly instead of dropping folders silently.
- **Expanded posting (`crates/app/src/posting.rs`):**
  - Expand enabled copies using `cl::transform::translate`.
  - In `ByTool` mode, run each member operation in folder order across all enabled copies inside one `SECTION` with safe clearance-plane rapid links between copies so shipped posts (`assets/posts/*.cps`) do not emit redundant `T.. M6` tool changes.
  - In `ByPart` mode, run all member operations at one enabled copy before moving to the next enabled copy.
  - Preserve `viewer_map` line-to-position mapping for every expanded copy.

## Done means

Tests create, edit, reorder, undo, redo, save, and reload a linear pattern folder and a grid pattern folder through commands and MCP, disable one copy, and pin deterministic golden NC output for `ByTool` (without redundant tool changes between copies) and `ByPart` orders.

Part of #2938
